mutations.name: M1 a stale manager view still renders 'offline'/'not in roster' as if they were verdicts
mutations.find: if (r.meshView === "stale") return c.yellow("mesh unknown") + c.dim(" (manager's presence view is stale)");
mutations.expectRed: stale view hides 'offline' behind mesh unknown

mutations.name: M2 an unpopulated manager view still renders 'not in roster' as a verdict
mutations.find: if (r.meshView === "unpopulated") return c.yellow("mesh unknown") + c.dim(" (manager's presence view not yet populated)");
mutations.expectRed: unpopulated view hides 'absent' behind mesh unknown
